description: The Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia intends to procure Faro cleaning, calibrating, certification, and if necessary, repairs on a sole source basis from Faro Technologies, Inc. (Cage 0VGY2). The proposed contract action is for supplies or services for which the Government intends to solicit and award with only one source under authority of FAR 13.106(b). Any questions regarding this notice should be emailed to:rachel.m.piecyk.civ@us.navy.mil. Phone calls will NOT be accepted.
